trust_decision.summary: Whether a JITServer message received from the peer (client->server request or server->client reply) is structurally valid before its descriptors and typed payloads are read; decided only partly in Message::deserialize (outer descriptors) while per-type payload reads in RawTypeConvert::onRecv rely on TR_ASSERT only and the message type indexes a static array unchecked.

landing_point.why: Message::deserialize is the single message-parsing routine and already holds the StreamFailure bounds checks added by the sibling CVE fixes (5ce3357ff, 493c3eeb1); a reader of 'out-of-bounds reads during message parsing' starts here.

fix_sites.entry_point: CommunicationStream::readMessage via ServerStream::read/readCompileRequest (server, remote client socket) and ClientStream::read (client, server reply)
getArgsRaw (std::string args, e.g. AOTCacheMap_request name at runtime/compiler/net/ServerStream.hpp:169)
getArgsRaw (nested VECTOR args, e.g. std::vector<std::string> records in compilationCode replies)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: Fix diff is empty (merge header only), so whether the published fix also reached runtime/compiler/runtime/JITServerAOTSerializationRecords.hpp:74-79,424-429 cannot be confirmed; recorded as O8 instead.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The AOT-cache serialized method/records are opaque std::string payloads that already passed the message-level checks and are handled by the AOT deserializer in runtime/, not by the net/ message parser named in the report; and they are server->client replies, where the server is 'trusted'.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate encodings that a naive size/type check would reject: 64-bit aligned payloads with _dataOffset 4, BOOL with 3 bytes padding, EMPTY_VECTOR with zero payload, nested VECTOR/TUPLE descriptors, and compilationInterrupted/connectionTerminate messages sent with zero data points regardless of template arity.

O6_input_shapes: STRING with payload size beyond message
SIMPLE_VECTOR with wrong element size or non-multiple payload
nested VECTOR with element count/next-descriptor walking past parent
TUPLE with inner descriptors past parent

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Client parses server-supplied SerializedAOTMethod from compilationCode/AOTCache_serializedAOTMethod replies with only a TR_ASSERT size check, then reads code/data via its internal size fields
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Lives in the AOT cache module, not the net/ message parser; payload already passed message bounds checks as a std::string.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different package (runtime/ vs net/), consumed in runtime/compiler/control/JITClientCompilationThread.cpp:3335,3365

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Client parses each server-supplied AOTSerializationRecord string with only a TR_ASSERT size check before cacheRecord reads its fields
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Same as above; records are 'validated' later by cacheRecord, and the on-disk load path already validates via isValidHeader, suggesting this is handled elsewhere.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An additional RawTypeConvert specialisation (e.g. for an enum or std::pair) whose onRecv reads getDataStart() without the size/type check
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: New wire types are added by adding a specialisation here (comment at runtime/compiler/net/Message.hpp:92-95), and the existing ones use TR_ASSERT-only checks a maintainer would copy.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Contrast route: on-disk AOT cache records validated via isValidHeader; a wire-path deserializer that skips the equivalent check is a realistic save/reload-vs-network differential
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The same record structs are produced by two paths (file load and network reply) and only the file path has explicit header validation.
